notes.title: V1.0.3 Tips for Customization
notes.content:
1) To select card set and game variant, first click the Rules button above, before starting a game

2) If you want to play with classic card images, deactivate "Colored cards" option. You can define special cards then just the way you like to play the game!

3) Click Options > Settings (main menu) to select your favorite from 3 classic card sets!

notes.title: Release August 8th
notes.content:
Game will be released this Saturday August 8th, 2020.

A lot of different rule variations of world-wide popular card games Crazy Eights and Mau-Mau wait for you: with Tutorial, Singleplayer and Multiplayer!
